'''Viella Zall''' was a [[Musician/Legends|singer]] on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]]<ref name="Slicers">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|Identity Slicers}}</ref> [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Communications grid/Legends|communications grid]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|II|52|Holonet}}</ref> Using local wildlife, [[Dalan Reid]] constructed replicas of Zall in the dozens. Reid's work began after he spent twelve [[Standard year/Legends|years]] in isolation, becoming increasingly [[Brain/Legends|mentally]] imbalanced due to the illegality of his job as a veteran [[identity slicer]]. The slicer used the replicas for a spontaneous [[Music/Legends|concert]] on<ref name="Slicers" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where he was [[Prisoner/Legends|apprehended]]<ref name="Slicers" /> by [[3630 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|4.3}} Since the Identity Slicers Codex entry, which mentions Viella Zall, was added with Game Update 4.3, it can be placed in that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], as well.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Viella Zall was mentioned in the Codex entry for Identity Slicers in the [[2015]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by the company [[BioWare]].<ref name="Slicers" />
